title: Check AGB HV charge percentage in the Power section after selecting an AGB
summary: After selecting the AGB in the OptiSweep/HMI interface, a small “power” section shows the AGB’s HV charge percentage (example: 50%). Use this value to judge whether extended troubleshooting time risks the AGB “dying” (operational concern discussed in the source).
when_to_use: Use when you have selected an AGB in the OptiSweep/HMI interface and you need to quickly assess its HV charge percentage to understand whether an extended troubleshooting window (e.g., ~1–2 hours) is likely to become risky.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for resolving the underlying fault condition; it only provides an HV charge percentage awareness check.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Select the target AGB in the OptiSweep/HMI interface and read the HV charge percentage from the small “power” section for operational risk awareness.
access_or_tools_needed: AGB selection access on the OptiSweep/HMI interface shown in the source
UI element/section labeled “power” that shows “charge percentage of the HV”

system_preconditions: The AGB must be selectable in the OptiSweep/HMI interface so that the small “power” section appears for the selected AGB.

visual_references.description: Frame showing the discussion: after selecting the AGB, a small “power” section displays HV charge percentage (example 50%) and mentions operational concern around ~30%/32% if troubleshooting takes 1–2 hours.

steps.title: Select the AGB you are working with in the AGB/HMI interface
steps.purpose: Selecting the AGB is required to expose the small “power” section that displays the HV charge percentage.
steps.instruction: In the OptiSweep/HMI interface, select the AGB you are working with so that the interface updates to show the AGB’s details.
steps.expected_result: The interface updates for the selected AGB such that a small section labeled “power” is available for reading HV charge percentage.
steps.healthy_condition: After selection, the “power” section is visible for the selected AGB.
steps.failure_condition: After selecting the AGB, the “power” section (labeled “power”) is not displayed.

actions.label: Select AGB
actions.exact_action: Select the AGB you are working with.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the HV charge percentage is not displayed after selecting the AGB, stop and escalate for assistance.

source_evidence.quote: “if you select the AGB, there's a small section over here that says power, it will tell you the charge percentage of the HV. So it's at 50%.”

steps.failure_condition: The “power” section cannot be found or is not shown for the selected AGB.

steps.title: Read the HV charge percentage from the “power” section
steps.purpose: The HV charge percentage is the key value used to judge operational risk during extended troubleshooting.
steps.instruction: In the “power” section, read the “charge percentage of the HV” value for the selected AGB.
steps.expected_result: A numeric HV charge percentage is displayed in the “power” section (example from source: 50%).
steps.healthy_condition: The “power” section shows a “charge percentage of the HV” value (e.g., 50% as in the source example).
steps.failure_condition: The “power” section does not show a HV charge percentage value.

actions.label: Read HV charge %
actions.exact_action: Read the “charge percentage of the HV” shown in the power section.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the HV charge percentage is not displayed after selecting the AGB, stop and escalate for assistance.

source_evidence.quote: “it will tell you the charge percentage of the HV. So it's at 50%.”

steps.title: Assess operational risk based on the displayed HV charge percentage
steps.purpose: The source discusses that lower HV charge percentages become a concern if troubleshooting takes about an hour or two.
steps.instruction: Compare the displayed HV charge percentage to the operational concern range discussed in the source (example concern around ~30% / 32% when troubleshooting may take ~1–2 hours).
steps.expected_result: You determine whether the displayed HV charge percentage is in the operationally concerning area discussed by the source (e.g., around 30%/32% for ~1–2 hours of troubleshooting).
steps.healthy_condition: The HV charge percentage is read and you can make an operational awareness judgment aligned to the source discussion (e.g., ~30%/32% is concerning if delays are ~1–2 hours).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot make the operational awareness judgment because the HV charge percentage is missing/unreadable.

actions.label: Compare to concern range
actions.exact_action: Compare the displayed HV charge percentage to the concern range mentioned in the source (example: 30% / 32%).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the HV charge percentage is not displayed after selecting the AGB, stop and escalate for assistance.

source_evidence.quote: “So if, if you're already working with something that is like 30%, thirty 2%, if it's taking us, I don't know, an hour or two to, you know, fix the issue we're, you know, kind of edging towards that area, right.”

success_criteria: After selecting the AGB, the “power” section displays the “charge percentage of the HV” value for that AGB.
The HV charge percentage is read and used to make an operational risk awareness judgment for the expected troubleshooting duration.

escalation_guidance: If the HV charge percentage is not displayed after selecting the AGB, stop and escalate for assistance (no alternate UI location/steps are provided in the source).
